functional_sequences.mechanism: Light reaches outer-segment pigments from the vitreal side; neural output returns toward the inner retina and exits in ganglion axons.

schematic_limitations: The existing cells have no assigned ON/OFF identities. Do not recolor individual cells as verified subtypes. Outer IPL near INL is conventionally OFF; inner IPL near GCL is conventionally ON. Diverse and bistratified circuits are omitted. No simulated spike trace or receptive field. Rod signals must not be routed directly through this cone lesson.

functional_sequences.mechanism: Inner retinal perfusion and outer retinal support arise from separate vascular territories.

schematic_limitations: Ordered parts are semantic routes, not extracted posed centreline trajectories. Actual patency and travel direction along the mesh require later records/checks. Two plexus selectors simplify normal subdivisions. Red-to-blue color is schematic and does not quantify oxygen extraction. This is peripheral retina, not an avascular foveal inset.

description_replacements.text: Ganglion cell layer: retinal ganglion somata and displaced amacrine cells. Ganglion neurons integrate bipolar and amacrine input and send action-potential output along axons in the nerve fibre layer toward the optic nerve. Some amacrine cells also generate spikes. Representative cells and counts are illustrative.

description_replacements.replace_clause: Here roughly 1 in 10 photoreceptors is a cone, as in the paramacular retina.
description_replacements.with_clause: Illustrative cones among rods in a peripheral-retina teaching section; the displayed count is not a measured regional population ratio.

consumer_contract.application_path: Lead-supplied apply_teaching.py creates existing viewer named-camera presets: one per teaching_view_id, with corresponding note and hidden_parts. Function state data is embedded as metadata and retained separately as function.json. User selects cameras to advance educational steps; there is no native electrophysiology or mesh-flow playback.
operations: Create named camera preset for each teaching_view_id using camera context and hidden_parts
Attach concise note to each named camera; retain caption, state values and limitations in function.json metadata
Resolve selectors by exact part_contract names
Advance manually by choosing named cameras; no unsupported animations
Preserve original materials and restore default visibility after lesson
unsupported_behaviors: Physics or electrophysiology inferred from labels
ON/OFF subtypes assigned to arbitrary generic meshes
consumer_contract.lead_application: apply_teaching.py produces adjacent retina_refined.viewer.json, retina_function.json and retina_function.html; exact named camera keys match every teaching_view_id
